summary: 1940 fire tower on Windy Mountain in Shoshone National Forest, Park County, Wyoming; gone, with only the tower piers left at the site.

facts.design: Modified L-4-style cabin on a 20-foot open timber tower
facts.status_note: Gone; all that remains at the site are the tower piers
facts.agency: US Forest Service - Shoshone National Forest

events.note: Register gives 1940; the 1940 brochure describes the tower as being erected that year, and the handbook (printed 1941) says it was being erected
Added to the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on May 1, 2022

evidence.supports: 1940 new tower erected on Windy Mountain, 6 miles south of Crandall Ranger Station
evidence.quote: A new tower is being erected on Windy Mountain, located 6 miles south of the Crandall Ranger Station.

evidence.supports: handbook (printed 1941): fire towers under construction or planned
evidence.quote: Fire towers, which will make visible a large part of the forest, are in process of construction or are contemplated.

evidence.supports: handbook also mentions new tower on Clayton Mountain and tower being erected on Windy Mountain
evidence.quote: In addition to the new tower on Clayton Mountain, another is being erected on Windy Mountain

evidence.supports: intended view over North Absaroka wilderness including 1935 Crandall Creek fire area
evidence.quote: This will make visible a large portion of this immense country in the North Absaroka wilderness, including the area burned in the Crandall Creek fire of 1935.

evidence.supports: cabin appears to be modified L-4 design similar to Region 5 BC-301
evidence.quote: The cabin appears to be a modified L-4 design similar to the Region 5 BC-301.

evidence.supports: cabin stands on a 20-foot open timber tower
evidence.quote: The cabin is standing on a 20 foot open timber tower.

evidence.supports: register photo of the lookout dated 1959
evidence.quote: Windy Mountain Lookout - 1959 - courtesy of Eunice Heiser

evidence.supports: no removal date; only tower piers remain at the site
evidence.quote: Removal date is unknown. All that remains at the site are the tower piers.

evidence.supports: listing marks the tower as gone
added to the register on May 1, 2022

sources.title: Shoshone National Forest, Wyoming (handbook, printed 1941), section 6

notes_for_editor: Only four pages describe this lookout, and none gives a staffing record, so staffing is omitted; two web searches found nothing more. Elevation differs slightly: 10,276 ft (register, matches record 3,132 m) vs 10,267 ft (firelookout.com). Firelookout.com says '20' wooden L-4 tower' where the register says the cabin 'appears to be' a modified L-4 on an open timber tower; both are compatible. Height to cab floor is not stated, so height_m is omitted. The 1940 brochure says '6 miles' and the handbook (printed 1941) says 'about 6 miles' from the Crandall Ranger Station. Access status is not found, so access is omitted. Crandall Ranger Station restoration articles surfaced in search but do not mention this lookout and were not used.
